prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before any model prediction was computed in code. Not blinded: the ESRD group means were read before writing this plan, and a rough mental calculation suggested that holding non-renal clearance at the normal-group value (about 29 mL/min) over-predicts ESRD exposure by about 1.3-fold if residual renal clearance is near zero. Disclosed here; the scenarios and the classification rule were fixed regardless.
not_this: Not validation; group means of 6 subjects.
Not a dialysis model: no dialyser, blood-flow or session parameters are used.
Not a dosing or dialysis-timing recommendation.

questions.primary: With elimination split as in Simulation 2.0a (calibrated on the normal group only, intact-nephron reading, non-renal clearance held constant), is the ESRD non-dialysis-day AUC predicted?
descriptive: Non-renal clearance implied by each group's observed CL and fraction excreted unchanged (normal to severe).
Amount of a 25 mg dose removed by one 4-hour haemodialysis session, from the paired on- and off-dialysis profiles.

data.model: intelligence_store/lenalidomide_renal_pathways.py (calibrate, pathways; primary calibration: normal CrCl 110 mL/min, fu 0.77)

primary_prediction.formula: AUC = dose / (CLR + CLNR), with CLNR the normal-group value and CLR from the intact-nephron reading at the assumed residual creatinine clearance.
primary_prediction.why: Residual kidney function of the ESRD subjects is not reported. 0 means anuric; 10 is the lower end of the range used for severe impairment in 2.0a.
primary_prediction.interval: 95% CI of the observed mean AUC: mean +/- t(0.975, 5) x SD / sqrt(6).
primary_prediction.rule: Constant non-renal clearance is called consistent with the ESRD data if the prediction is inside the interval in at least the 0 mL/min scenario. If it over-predicts in all three scenarios, record as a finding that non-renal (or residual) elimination in ESRD exceeds the normal-group non-renal clearance.

descriptive_methods.non_renal_by_group: CLNR_g = (dose / AUC_g) x (1 - fe_g) from group means (ratio of means); no interval, because fe has no reported spread.
descriptive_methods.dialysis_removal: Assuming the non-dialysis clearance applies throughout the dialysis day, drug eliminated by the body's own routes = CL_off x AUC_on, with CL_off = dose / AUC_off. Amount removed by dialysis = dose - CL_off x AUC_on; reported in mg and as a fraction of the dose. Bioavailability taken as 1.
descriptive_methods.not_computed: Dialyser clearance during the session, which needs concentrations during the session (not reported).

never: No parameter is fitted to the ESRD groups.
known_differences: ESRD subjects may have residual urine output; it is not reported.
Uraemia can change non-renal clearance and bioavailability; neither is measured here.
Group means of 6 subjects; the dialysis derivation assumes unchanged non-dialysis clearance on the dialysis day.
